meta_description: Architecture and security posture of Fleet Management System (FMS) — tracking, maintenance and telematics analytics.

blocks.x: How FMS is built: telematics ingestion, maintenance models and the apps that keep drivers and operations in step.

Telematics devices stream into a cloud data platform; rules and machine-learning models turn the stream into maintenance schedules and route recommendations. The driver app and the operations dashboard read from the same data, so dispatch and drivers always agree.
